Subject: RapidSprint MAP starter + week0 doc — draft attached

Hi Arielle —

Great talking earlier. As promised, attached is a compact MAP template we use for 30–45 day pilots (RapidSprint) plus a one-slide week0 slide deck that outlines success criteria and tech validation checkpoints. The goal here is to give your team a lightweight, editable starting point we can align on in the first sync.

What I uploaded:
- RapidSprint_MAP_Template_v1.docx (editable) — MAP sections: goals, acceptance criteria, stakeholders, tech touchpoints, week-by-week milestones, risks and mitigations, decision gate.
- Week0-stub-slides.pptx — a 1–2 slide summary you can put in your kickoff with stakeholders.

Primary asks from you:
1) Confirm the stakeholders you want attending the kickoff (names + roles).
2) Flag any non-standard success metrics (SLOs, latency, data residency).
3) Tell us if procurement/legal should be copied now (happy to include procurement thread).

Proposed next step: 30-minute kickoff this Thursday 10:00–10:30 PT to review the MAP and lock week0 owners. If that works I will send a calendar invite and update the doc with names.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
